title: MGAL: A Multilingual Granularity-Aware Long-Context Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.20853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluation of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced rapidly. However, most existing benchmarks are limited to the document level and focus mainly on high-resource languages, leaving many fine-grained challenges insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we present MGAL, the first multilingual, granularity- and position-aware long-context benchmark. MGAL is constructed from United Nations (UN) reports spanning 8K to 128K tokens across the six official UN languages. It covers four coherent levels of linguistic granularity (word, sentence, paragraph, and document) and further stratifies entries by their position within the document (begin, middle, and end), indexed at both the document and paragraph levels. This design enables systematic diagnosis of multilingual long-context comprehension across different granularities.   Through extensive experiments and analyses, we find that: (1) LLMs perform well at word-level task

translated_title: MGAL：一个多语言粒度感知的长上下文基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20853v1 公告类型：新 摘要：长上下文大型语言模型（LLMs）的评估进展迅速。然而，现有的大多数基准仅限于文档级别，并主要关注高资源语言，导致许多细粒度挑战未得到充分评估。为解决这一缺口，我们提出了MGAL，这是首个多语言、粒度和位置感知的长上下文基准。MGAL基于联合国（UN）报告构建，涵盖六种联合国官方语言，跨度从8K到128K个标记。它覆盖四个连贯的语言粒度级别（词、句、段和文档），并进一步根据条目在文档中的位置（开头、中间和结尾）进行分层，同时在文档和段落级别建立索引。这一设计使得能够跨不同粒度系统性地诊断多语言长上下文理解能力。通过大量实验和分析，我们发现：（1）LLMs在词级任务上表现良好。
tldr: 本文提出了MGAL，首个多语言、粒度与位置感知的长上下文基准，基于联合国报告构建，覆盖词、句、段、文档四个粒度级别及文档内位置分层，以系统评估多语言长上下文理解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MGAL, the first multilingual, granularity- and position-aware long-context benchmark built from UN reports, covering four linguistic granularity levels and document positions to systematically evaluate multilingual long-context comprehension.
